episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Scooby-Doo and the gang meet up with basketball legend Chris Paul at a golf tournament fundraiser held in Florida. Shaggy's come to caddy for Mr. Paul and help him with this game so the Assist King can save a local school from going under.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Scooby-Doo and the gang travel to Chambersburg, a battlefield near Gettysburg, to investigate the mysterious appearance of ghost zombie Civil War soldiers and come face to face with a rival mystery solving gang, the Funky Phantom crew.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Scooby and the gang meet Wanda Sykes, who is helping save a bunch of animals up for adoption in a pet supply store. But, when a monster egg hatches, our heroes and Wanda must not only save the store and the animals, but their own lives!

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: When Scooby and the gang are taking a tour of London, they run afoul of horrible screaming skulls of English legend! They team up with an eccentric man who claims to be none other than Sherlock Holmes. He can't be the real thing, can he?

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: When our mystery solving gang agrees to help Ricky Gervais with a haunted antique Egyptian statue of a cat, they find themselves embroiled in a confrontation with the ancient goddess Bast in mummy form!

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: When a marble statue comes to life at a museum in Greece, our gang is caught between a braying minotaur and a sword-wielding Wonder Woman! Teaming up with Themyscira, the Mystery Inc. gang experiences a little rift of boys versus girls.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: When our mystery solving gang accepts the invitation to spend one night in the haunted Savannah Hotel in Las Vegas before its controlled demolition, they find that they're not alone. Magicians Penn & Teller have also accepted the challenge.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: When Steve Urkel enlists the help of our gang to track down the Urkel-Bot, they stumble onto a deeper mystery with the appearance of a Technomancer, controlling all the robots! Can our gang survive an onslaught of the angry robots?

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: When Scooby and Shaggy compete in a fast food eating competition, they meet their ultimate challenge eating against none other than comedian Jim Gaffigan! Oh yeah, and there's also a monster trying to stop the contest from finishing.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Driving through the Rocky Mountains, the Mystery Inc. gang discovers a sleep-away accordion camp run by none other than Weird Al Yankovic!  But there is no accordion joy when a horrible dinosaur (a dreaded allosaurus) attacks the camp.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: When Daphne gets a call from singer-songwriter Sia, the gang finds themselves in a mystery involving an evil demon ghost that has taken the shape of Sia as a ghostly doppelgänger that steals countless gems and jewelry.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Shaggy and Scooby take the gang to meet their good friend, Kenan Thompson. He's preparing to broadcast a one-man show. But when a Ghost Clown attacks, all the many characters Kenan has created will never see the light of day.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: When Scooby and the gang come to Gotham City to visit Alfred Pennyworth, they stumble into a dangerous mystery! Alfred's been kidnapped by the Man-Bat! Batman is on the case and he does not want any help from our meddling kids.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: While driving through snowy mountains, Mystery Inc. comes across a remote university where they meet Whoopi Goldberg, who is a student at the university.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: While in Japan, the gang run into Mark Hamill, who's having a class reunion. A mystery presents itself when a fox monster kidnaps one of Hamill's old teachers.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Shaggy and Scooby try to find some time to eat with their pal Barry Allen (aka the Flash).

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Mystery Inc. meet George Takei while exploring the Hollywood Hills' most haunted historic building. While there, they also run into a ghostly knight.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Scooby enters Shaggy in a poetry slam at Central Park, where his competitor is singer-songwriter Halsey.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: When Scooby and the gang are in Sicily, they’re chasing a fire monster! They're surprised to meet up with famous actor Steve Buscemi. His ancestors are from this area, and he has a lot of cousins in town and was just visiting.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: When Scooby and the gang are hired to escort a possessed ventriloquist dummy, they meet up with the two judges of the competition, Jeff Dunham and Darci Lynne Farmer and the possessed dummy attacks the competition.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: When famous dancer Maddie Ziegler wins an old, haunted dance studio in a competition, she asks her friend Daphne Blake and her mystery solving friends to help her investigate the place.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Scooby and our gang of mystery solving teens have been invited by famous comedian Jeff Foxworthy to help him move an old mansion that he’s just purchased. But, they find out the mansion is haunted by the ghost of an old witch.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Malcolm McDowell has made time travel possible, so he takes the gang along into the past, but an accident causes them to go into a nightmare future.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: When Daphne’s makeup vlog lands her as the prime consultant to the famous rock band, the Hex Girls, our gang find themselves embroiled in a rockin' mystery involving a cursed guitar that seems to control people's minds.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: When the gang teams up with Christian Slater, they find themselves at a redo prom for Christian's classmates to make up for the one they were deprived of when a horrible Wolfman appeared all those years ago.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 1 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: When Neil deGrasse Tyson gets trapped on the International Space Station with a horrible monster, Bill Nye arrives to save his good friend with the help of Velma and our mystery solving gang.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: The gang heads to Nashville, Tennessee to meet up with none other than country music legend Kacey Musgraves. Can our gang of mystery solvers help her save her show from the shadowy Phantom, or will it be the final curtain for all of them?

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Scooby and the gang, along with Morgan Freeman, are investigating mysterious ghost sightings at an old haunted prison that's been abandoned and derelict for over a hundred years.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: When investigating a haunted old hospital, Scooby and the gang meet up with actor and comedian Kristen Schaal. More importantly, can Kristen find out how she best fits into the group?

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Our mystery-solving gang is in Chicago investigating the haunting of a historic hot dog factory, when they team up with famous competitive eater Joey Chestnut who's in town for the annual hot dog eating competition.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: When Scooby Doo and the gang are on the trail of a monstrous gargoyle in the nighttime city of Paris, Velma turns to close friend and famous fashion model Gigi Hadid, who is in Paris for work.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: When Shaggy and Scooby are excited to visit a scary haunted old castle in Germany, the rest of the gang is confused until they meet up with none other than famous chef, writer and TV presenter Alton Brown.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: While investigating a mysterious ghost at the Dergfall Boldman Department store, the gang bumps into none other than fashion icon Tim Gunn. Can Tim Gunn solve the greatest mystery of all time?

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: When Scooby Doo and the gang are in Austria for the International Ice Games, they meet up with none other than famous Olympic gold medalist and sports commentator Tara Lipinski. Can Scooby Doo complete a quadruple axe?

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Hitting the ski slopes in the beautiful Rocky Mountains of Colorado, Scooby Doo and the gang run into none other than American gold medalist and famous snowboarder Chloe Kim, and she joins forces with our mystery solving gang.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: When Scooby Doo and the mystery solving gang wind up at the grand opening of a boxing museum created by boxing great Laila Ali, they must go toe to toe with a metal menace in order to save the museum.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: When Shaggy and Scooby meet up with their good friend Liza Koshy at an old haunted mansion, they find themselves the subject of her many fast-paced internet videos and at the center of a horrifying ghost attack.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: When the gang gets a mysterious invitation to a baseball game, they meet up with rapper and songwriter Macklemore, who is being attacked by a ghost mascot monster. Will our gang hit a home run?

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Scooby and mystery solving gang are on set with famous singer, dancer, comedian and actress Sandy Duncan. Can Sandy Duncan and our mystery solving gang survive this savage new Jekyll monster and solve the movie mystery?

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Velma and Shaggy are contestants on Jeopardy! competing against Andy the Brain Bot. But when Andy threatens to destroy everything, our gang and Alex Trebek must get to the bottom of who’s really behind this robot’s dangerous actions

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Scooby and Shaggy meet up with their biker buddy, Axl Rose, on a tour of famous roadside diners along iconic Route 66. However, they soon find themselves embroiled in a crazy mystery involving spooky mudmen.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: The gang goes treasure hunting for a lost shoe with Jason Sudeikis in the Amazon rainforest, but they quickly run into a mystery involving a snakeman monster.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: The Gang visit an art gallery to meet a friend of Scooby-Doo's. But when they arrive, instead of finding Lucy Liu they are accosted by a sculpture monster who is causing havoc before the official opening. But the big question is... Is Scooby's art any good?

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: A plant monster is haunting a hardware mega store. However, Daphne's friend, Sean Astin, is focused on returning a lost "ring of key" while the gang tries to solve the mystery. But maybe the two things are actually connected!

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Scooby-Doo and the gang are hitching a ride with their friend, Cher, on her yacht.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Fred takes a wrong turn at Nairobi and drives the gang to a lost valley.

episodes_data.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who? Season 2 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Our mystery teens work with Joseph "Run" Simmons (Run DMC) to get to the bottom of a mystery.
